verdict.rationale: The Gemini API is itself a headless programmatic surface, reachable over REST and official SDKs, with an asynchronous Batch API for bulk jobs. Google also documents an official stateless CLI, `gemini-api`, explicitly built for scripts and CI pipelines. Missing for 10: detailed CI setup documentation (non-interactive auth and secrets handling, exit codes, example pipeline configs) and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Gemini API CLI (`gemini-api`) is a stateless, zero-dependency command-line client built for AI agents with shell access, scripts, and CI pipelines.
The Gemini Batch API is designed to process large volumes of requests asynchronously at 50% of the standard cost.
The Google GenAI SDK is available for the Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go and Java languages.
